title: LionByteGG Ecosystem — Complete Technical & User Manual (Source Data)
purpose: Machine-readable reference covering every bot, cog, function, web route, kiosk, and setting in the LionByteGG ecosystem. Intended as raw source material for compiling a printed/PDF book or internal wiki. Generated by exhaustive codebase analysis.
how_to_use: Each chapter file is a self-contained JSON document. Load them in order for a logical book flow, or jump directly to the system you need. Cross-references use the 'file' field to point at real source files in the repo (paths are relative to c:\LionByteGG\).

chapters.title: BoilerCraftGG — Minecraft/Purdue Network Discord Bot
chapters.summary: Student verification, temp voice channels, ticket system, chat monitoring (Minecraft chat -> Discord), admin tools. discord.py + SQLite.

chapters.title: LionBeatsGG — Discord Music Bot
chapters.summary: Node.js/discord.js v14 + Lavalink music bot. Slash/prefix commands, control panel, quiz game, REST API for dashboard integration.

chapters.title: LionShiftGG — Arena Shift Scheduling Discord Bot
chapters.summary: Student worker shift scheduling, clock in/out, shift offers/trades, time-off requests, reminders. Python discord.py.

chapters.title: LionByteGG Bot — Flagship PNW Esports Discord Bot
chapters.summary: Member onboarding, moderation/AutoMod sync, varsity team registration, voice channel generators, ticket system, GGLeap arena integrations, watchlist.

chapters.title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 1: Auth, Admin, Core Pages, Settings
chapters.summary: Flask app.py. Login/session system, permission model, admin user/group management, dashboard/moderation/users/logs/analytics/search pages.

chapters.title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 2: Rosters & Varsity Team Manager
chapters.summary: Player/team CRUD, multi-team assignment, registration approval workflow, Discord role sync, match stats/leaderboard, CSV import/export, encrypted PII.

chapters.title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 3: Music Dashboard & Ticket System
chapters.summary: Proxy layer to LionBeatsGG's REST API; ticket lifecycle management shared with all bots' ticket_log.json + notification queues.

chapters.title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 4: LionShift, BoilerCraft & Equipment Dashboards
chapters.summary: Shift scheduling admin UI, Minecraft server admin UI, arena equipment/inventory + QR code checkout system.

chapters.title: Arena Kiosk System — Nova Backend (Sign-in, PC Booking, Locks, Analytics)
chapters.summary: The most complex subsystem: kiosk config, PC availability via GGLeap, sign-in guard/anti-spam, PC lock/unlock automation, analytics, student profiles, incident reports.

chapters.title: Arena Kiosk — Physical Devices, Templates & Deployment
chapters.summary: The actual kiosk web pages (arena_kiosk1.html/arena_kiosk2.html), the standalone deployed HTML files in 'Arena Kiosks/', boot sequence, trap/lock, floor map.

chapters.title: Operations Guide — Startup/Shutdown, Common Issues & Fixes, Settings Glossary
chapters.summary: How to start/stop every service, where every settings file lives and what each key means, known gotchas and their fixes, restart procedures.

discord_bots.name: LionByteGG
discord_bots.entry: main.py (or run_combined.py to also launch the web dashboard)

web_dashboard.name: Nova
databases: arena_db.py (arena.db - signins, students, watchlist, flags, encrypted PII)
web_dashboard.serves: All bot dashboards (LionByteGG, BoilerCraft, LionShift, LionBeats music) + Arena Kiosk system + physical kiosk pages

control_panel.name: Master Terminal
control_panel.purpose: PyQt6 GUI to start/stop/monitor all 6 services (LionByteGG bot, LionShiftGG bot, BoilerCraftGG bot, LionBeatsGG bot, Lavalink, Nova web) from one window.

master_launcher.name: Start LionServices.bat
master_launcher.purpose: Single-instance-guarded batch script that launches all 6 services in order, then opens Master Terminal.

shared_data_directory.path: LionByteGG\data\ (referred to as DATA_DIR in app.py)
shared_data_directory.purpose: Cross-service communication hub. Bots write status/cache files here; the web dashboard reads them. The web dashboard writes notification/command queue files here; each bot polls its own queue file and acts on it.
shared_data_directory.note: NOT the same as LionByteGG\web\data\ (a separate, web-only data folder used by some equipment/QR/auth features).
